Definition: a form of G2014; to illuminate (figuratively):--give light.
BiblicalUsage: Epiphauo means to give light, to shine upon — and Paul quotes the call: Awake thou that sleepest, and arise from the dead, and Christ shall give thee light.
TheologicalSignificance: He does not only show the way, He shines on the sleeper until the sleeper wakes: the light is Christ Himself.
